basics.label: Computer Science Student
basics.summary: Currently I am a Computer Science Master Student at University of Trento specializing in Cybersecurity. Official team member of E-Agle Trento Racing Team where I work as Telemetry Technician.

work.name: E-Agle Trento Racing Team
work.summary: Proud official member of the E-Agle Trento Racing Team, an only student university team, which designs, builds and races a single-seater electric car in the Formula SAE competitions.
highlights: I worked a year as Telemetry Technician in the E-Agle Trento Racing Team, developing the in-house self-made telemetry system which allows the team to monitor the car's signals in real-time during the tests and races.
achievements: I researched and documented a function optimization which allows the telemetry system to significantly improve the deserialization of the messages received from the car.
I made a fully working SPI to CAN overlay on a Raspberry Pi 5 to allow the telemtry system to communicate directly to with the CAN bus of the car.
I researched which database to use for our Telemetry system reading documentation and running simulations to find the best solution for our needs.
I designed and implement the system which allows the telemetry system to communicate with the database of sensor's signals.

work.name: Uniweb Srl
work.summary: Managing a Cybersecurity Platform and Risk Management Activities. SGBox SIEM configuration and managment with integration of data sources and data correlation to analyze cyberattacks on a high-availability network infrastructure based on a VMware virtualization environment.Acquisition of expertise in data collection and event correlation on an innovative Security Information and Event Management system.Vulnerability Scans on a variety of hosts with Qualys and Greenbone.
achievements: I configured and managed the SGBox SIEM platform, integrating various data sources and implementing data correlation techniques to analyze cyberattacks on a production industrial environment.
I acquired expertise in data collection and event correlation on an innovative Security Information and Event Management system.
I conducted vulnerability scans on a variety of hosts using Qualys and Greenbone, identifying potential security risks and providing recommendations for mitigation.

work.name: Università degli Studi dell'Insubria
work.summary: Tutoring activity for the CyberChallenge.IT 2025 course at the University of Insubria. I'm the winner of the CyberChallenge.IT 2024 local competition and  I took part in the national competition in Turin with 5 other students, representing the University of Insubria. After this successful experience, I was chosen as a mentor for the following edition of the academic course.
achievements: I held a lecture about Docker and Networking for the CyberChallenge.IT 2025 course at the University of Insubria.
I helped in variuos exercise activities about Capture The Flag (CTF) challenges
